nodes.name: Daily 06:00 UTC
nodes.notes: Runs every 6 hours at :00 (0 6,12,18,0 * * *). To run every 3 hours: '0 */3 * * *'. To run every hour: '0 * * * *'. For daily at 9am UTC: '0 9 * * *'.

nodes.name: GET /trigger-sync
nodes.notes: Set url to your Railway API: https://your-app.railway.app/trigger-sync. Returns 202 + job_id immediately; sync runs in background. Use GET /trigger-sync?key=SYNC_TRIGGER_KEY if SYNC_TRIGGER_KEY is set in Railway.
